title: Best OP Auto Collect Auto Hatch Auto Sell Auto Rebirth
features:
Ronix Hub - +1 Wings For Eggs

Flight
- Fly Speed slider from 50 to 500, used for every flight the hub makes for you
- Anti-AFK, on by default
- Teleport to any world your rebirths unlock, Forest through Ancient Egypt
- Go To Spawn puts you back on your base

Collect
- Auto Collect Eggs near you, with a Target Zone filter
- Collect Interval slider from 0.5 to 10 seconds
- Return Home After Collecting, on by default
- Collect Now button

Hatch
- Auto Hatch Eggs opens eggs on your base once their timer is done
- Hatch Delay slider from 0.1 to 5 seconds
- Open All Ready Eggs button

Sell
- Auto Sell Friends on a 5 to 300 second timer
- Sell All Now button, with an optional trip home afterwards

Place
- Auto Place Egg collects, heads home and places on your base, on repeat
- Auto Place Friend places what you carry once you hold enough (1 to 10)
- Pick a friend from your backpack, Equip Friend, then Place Now

Upgrades
- Auto Buy Speed, Stamina and Carry Limit, each with its own target level
- Max Upgrade Price and Minimum Balance Reserve limits on upgrade spending
- Upgrade Interval slider and a Buy Now button for each upgrade
- Live level and next price for every upgrade

Wings
- Pick a wing and Buy Wing Now
- Equip any wing from the list, and see which one you have on

Rebirth and Money
- Auto Rebirth
- Live rebirth level and earnings
- Auto Collect Earnings on a 5 to 120 second timer, or Collect Earnings Now
- Auto Claim Daily Reward, or Claim Daily Now

Friends
- Auto Equip Best Friends on a timer, or Equip Best Now
- Auto decline trade requests

Performance
- FPS Boost with flat materials and no shadows
- FPS Cap from 30 to 360

Webhook
- Session report to your Discord webhook every 10 minutes
- Send Test Report button

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
